_doc: Reference data for benchmarking the Castor pipeline against an AEC (architecture/engineering/construction) project-management B2B SaaS for mid-market general contractors.

venture_under_test.name: BuildLane
venture_under_test.description: BuildLane is a B2B SaaS construction project-management platform combining RFI tracking, drawing version control, daily logs, submittals, and field-to-office reporting for mid-market general contractors with 50-500 employees executing $50M-$500M annual project volume. Pricing is $300 per active project per month with unlimited users. Target buyer: VP of Operations, Director of Field Operations, and Project Executive at GC firms running 10+ concurrent projects. We compete with Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud, Fieldwire, PlanGrid, and Buildertrend. Differentiation: drawing-version-control-first UX (vs Procore's RFI-first), per-project pricing model (no per-seat tax), and native field-mobile experience offline-capable for remote sites with poor connectivity.
venture_under_test.category: B2B vertical SaaS for AEC / construction project management

expected_pipeline_outputs._tam_note: Defensible US construction-tech scoping: bottom-up 25k mid-market GCs × $30k ACV = $750M narrow band; mid-narrow $2-4B (full PM software + adjacent), broad $5-8B (PM + scheduling + safety + financials stack). Pipeline TAM mid acceptable in $0.6B-$8B range.
